# function: appmesh_gateway_route

Builds the ARN for `appmesh` `gatewayRoute`:

```
arn:${Partition}:appmesh:${Region}:${Account}:mesh/${MeshName}/virtualGateway/${VirtualGatewayName}/gatewayRoute/${GatewayRouteName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:appmesh:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:mesh/mesh-name/virtualGateway/virtual-gateway-name/gatewayRoute/gateway-route-name
output "appmesh_gateway_route" {
  value = provider::arn::appmesh_gateway_route("mesh-name", "virtual-gateway-name", "gateway-route-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
appmesh_gateway_route(mesh_name string, virtual_gateway_name string, gateway_route_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `mesh_name` (String) Value for `${MeshName}` in the ARN template.
1. `virtual_gateway_name` (String) Value for `${VirtualGatewayName}` in the ARN template.
1. `gateway_route_name` (String) Value for `${GatewayRouteName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
